summary_en: This note studies the limit of a sequence involving the average of terms of the form \(n^{1/\log_2 k}\). The main method converts the sum into an integral, applies the substitution \(x=ne^{-t}\), and uses piecewise estimation to show the sum is asymptotic to \(3n\), so the limit is 3.
key_techniques_discussed: endpoint maximum estimation for exponential integrands
connections_mentioned: handling Taylor expansion remainders through substitution
